name: Kricketot
description: When the trees take on new hues, more of these Pokémon appear. The tone they create by striking their antennae together resembles that of the marimba, an instrument of foreign lands.

moves.name: Pound
moves.description: The target is physically pounded with a long tail, a foreleg, or the like.

moves.name: Growl
moves.description: The user growls in an endearing way, making opposing Pokémon less wary. This lowers their Attack stats.

moves.name: Struggle Bug
moves.description: While resisting, the user attacks opposing Pokémon. This lowers the Sp. Atk stats of those hit.

moves.name: Bug Bite
moves.description: The user bites the target. If the target is holding a Berry, the user eats it and gains its effect.
